text_block_list.text: While I'm out with Смарт Фалкон...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer. Seeing how we still have
some time
before we have to get back...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to do with you.
Is that
okay?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: What do you want to do?

text_block_list.text: In a word—location scouting!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
When people watch a music video from
a top
Umadol, not only do they expect
excellent
cinematography and editing...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
They also won't be satisfied unless I film
in a
location that fully highlights my
charms!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
If I wanna release cute music videos like
that
someday, I've gotta start learning
right now!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: I see! Sure then, why not!

text_block_list.text: Woohoo! I knew you'd say yes! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's right! Since I've got you here,
I wanna
know what you think! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
What's the perfect location to showcase
my
cuteness?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
An aquarium! Now that just screams
"cute"!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
We could call it... "Aquatic ☆ Love."
Perfect! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
All right! ☆ Since we've decided, let's
go!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
So Смарт Фалкон and I head straight to
the local
aquarium...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Wow! Look at all the pretty little fish! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Look at this one, Trainer! Its fins look
just like a
frilly skirt!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: It's kind of like an Umadol outfit.

text_block_list.text: ...Ah! That's what I was just thinking!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Great minds think alike, huh, Тренер? ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: I guess you're rubbing off on me.

text_block_list.text: Ehehe! Maybe!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
But we've still got a ways to go! I'm
going to keep
on taking center stage...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
And I'm definitely going to fulfill my
dream of
becoming the cutest top
Umadol!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Yeah! I'm counting on you! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Anyway, that's one more reason why we
need to
find the perfect location.
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
I'll leave you in charge of taking
reference pics! ☆
But watch out for the
tanks where cameras aren't
allowed!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
A movie theater! That'll be a new one for
me!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
"Cinematic ☆ Love"... Yeah! That's the
perfect
song name! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: All right! ☆ If we're decided, let's go!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
So Смарт Фалкон and I head over to a
local movie
theater.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
...Okay! First, we need to see what's
playing!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
The vibe of a theater totally changes
depending
on what kind of people are
there—families,
groups of friends,
couples... ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: You've given this a lot of thought!

text_block_list.text:
Of course! The secret to location
scouting is in
the power of observation!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Oh, Idol ☆ Glitter Saga is playing! I didn't know it was already out!
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
It's about an idol sister duo chosen by
the stars,
and their path to the super
stage...
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text: Really?! C-can we?
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон
choice_data_list: Might as well, since we're here.

text_block_list.text: Wow! Thanks, Trainer! ☆
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
Let's finish location scouting first, and
then we
can enjoy the rest of the day
together! ♪
text_block_list.name: Смарт Фалкон

text_block_list.text:
After enjoying both the scouting and the
movie, I
head back to campus with a
very pleased Smart
Falcon.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
After that, we continue scouting for
good
locations at the aquarium until
Smart Falcon is
satisfied.
text_block_list.name: Монолог
